claim: BOLAV1 is the re-check head of the BOLAVA lava-avoid episode. It reloads PPOSY+1 (the enemy's whole-pixel Y) to decide whether the bird has escaped the lava since the last wake. BOLAV1 is reached only from a BOLAV2 (coast) wake, whose STD PJOY,U parked #BOLAV1 as the next entry address.

The BOLAV1 re-check threshold is the HEX constant $D3 (211 decimal) — the SAME line the hunter's B2DIRL gate compares against (:4098), and NOT the shadow's $D0 entry gate (:4331). A shadow ENTERS BOLAVA at $D0 but LEAVES it at $D3: PPOSY+1 < $D3 (BLO) exits to BOLAV4 and the brains. The two lava thresholds are distinct constants and must not be conflated.
Above $D3 the re-check branches to BOLAV4 (BLO = below-$D3), leaving the episode. The comment 'NOT ANY MORE' reads: the bird is no longer below CLIF5, so the lava avoid is done.
The second BOLAV1 exit test loads PVELY (vertical velocity). A rising bird already leaves the lava on its own, so the episode ignores the lava and exits.

A NEGATIVE PVELY (rising) branches to BOLAV4 via BMI, exiting the episode ('IGNORE LAVA'). So BOLAV1 stays in the flap cycle only while the bird is at/below $D3 AND falling (PVELY >= 0) — the same falling-gate the divert entries require.
BOLAVA is the FLAP head of the episode and the address both steering gates JMP to on a divert. It arms the NEXT wake at BOLAV2 by loading #BOLAV2 into D for the STD PJOY,U that follows.

BOLAVA writes PJOY,U — the per-process entry address the scheduler jumps through next wake — with #BOLAV2, so the wake after a BOLAVA flap enters at BOLAV2 (the coast). This is the entry-address ping-pong, the same PJOY,U mechanism LINET's LNTOFP glide uses.

BOLAVA FLAPS the wings: LDB #1 loads the joystick flap bit (B=1) that BODIR carries into the flight impulse. This is the protective lava flap the divert forces, overriding whatever flap the brain had decided.
After setting the flap, BOLAVA falls through to BODIR3, the shared jump into BODIR — so the flap head and the coast head both steer through the BOUNDER homing routine.
BOLAV2 is the COAST head, entered the wake after a BOLAVA flap. It arms the next wake at BOLAV1 (the re-check) by loading #BOLAV1 for the STD PJOY,U that follows.

BOLAV2 CLRB clears the joystick flap bit (B=0) — wings UP, no flap this wake. The flap/coast alternation is exactly BOLAVA (flap) then BOLAV2 (coast) then BOLAV1 (re-check), so a bird held below $D3 flaps every OTHER wake, not every wake.
BOLAV4 is the episode exit. It reloads the enemy's decision-block index PDECSN,U so the brains can re-decide this same wake — the lava avoid does not consume a wake once it has cleared.

source.verbatim: BOLAV4	LDX	PDECSN,U	BACK TO THE BRAINS

claim: BOLAV4 jumps indirectly through DSMART,X — the smart-brain vector selected by PDECSN — handing the wake back to the enemy's own brain (bounder/hunter/shadow). This is why leaving BOLAVA returns to the brain rather than a fixed routine.
